source.title: Lung ultrasound in the critically ill
source.whyItFits: Open review of the core thoracic ultrasound signs used at the bedside: A-lines, lung sliding, B-lines, effusion signs, and consolidation signs. The often-cited Volpicelli international recommendations are not in PMC.

notes: The BLUE-protocol paper's PMC record returned only a short file and was not used. Volpicelli 2012 is not in PMC.
